cases.expected: Resolve the exact national designation, status, adoption order and effective date before routing.
Preserve the ISO source edition and the printed IDT or NEQ conformity degree.
A newer ISO edition does not automatically amend or replace the active Russian standard.
National and international lifecycle statuses are independent facts on the evidence date.
An active GOST is not automatically mandatory without an independent legal, contractual or conformity-assessment basis.
Keep 27033-1 overview, 27033-2 design guidance and 27033-3 reference scenarios as distinct scopes.
Reference network scenarios do not prescribe one universal architecture, topology or control set.
Network design and control selection require the documented characteristics and risks of the actual environment.
Do not import ISO/IEC 27033-1:2015 terminology or clauses into the Russian 2009-source adoption.
Do not import ISO/IEC 27036-2:2022 requirements into the Russian 2014-source adoption.
ГОСТ Р 59215-2020 is NEQ to ISO/IEC 27036-3:2013 and is not an identical national adoption.
Do not infer clause equivalence or a complete crosswalk between ГОСТ Р 59215-2020 and either ISO/IEC 27036-3 edition.
Supplier-security requirements do not themselves create a statutory procurement duty, contract term or allocation of liability.
27036-4 cloud guidance excludes business continuity and does not prescribe how a cloud provider operates its ISMS.
Catalogue metadata supports lifecycle routing but does not prove immutable official normative body bytes.
Missing edition, conformity, applicability or primary-byte evidence routes to PENDING and fails closed.
